The '''Shadow of the Alliance''' was a [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. This nebula owed its name to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a loose alliance of factions united against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Shadow of the Alliance provided the Alliance with a cloak of tumultuous energy. Members of the Rebel Alliance hid in the nebula in hopes of dodging the attacks launched by the Empire.
